names: International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer

events.text: The Mayflower sets sail from Plymouth, England, for the New World.
Miguel Hidalgo's Cry of Dolores begins the Mexican War of Independence.
General Motors is founded in Flint, Michigan.
Malaysia is formed from Malaya, Singapore, Sabah and Sarawak.
The new Metropolitan Opera House opens at Lincoln Center in New York.
Papua New Guinea gains independence from Australia.
The Montreal Protocol to protect the ozone layer is signed.
Black Wednesday: the pound sterling is forced out of the European Exchange Rate Mechanism.
